1.2 **The initial weight vector and block.** The row-filled tableau $t^\mu$ dominates every standard tableau of its shape at every prefix. Thus the triangular JM formula of [[thm-hecke-jucys-murphy-action-is-dominance-triangular]] has no off-diagonal terms at this vector. Star fixes $L_r$, so conversion to the left cell module gives $L_rz_\mu=[c-r]_\xi z_\mu$ for the node $(r,c)$ containing that entry. The multiplicative JM recurrence $X_{a+1}=\xi^{-1}T_aX_aT_a$ and the quadratic relation give $X_a=1+(\xi-1)L_a$: its inductive step is $L_{a+1}=\xi^{-1}T_aL_aT_a+\xi^{-1}T_a$. Hence $X_az_\mu=\xi^{i_a}z_\mu$ by $1+(\xi-1)[m]_\xi=\xi^m$, valid also for negative content. The weight idempotents and $y_a=(1-\xi^{-i_a}X_a)e(i)$ now give $e(i_{t^\mu})z_\mu=z_\mu$ and $y_az_\mu=0$. Since the vectors generated from $z_\mu$ have sequences obtained by permuting its residues, the whole cyclic module lies in content block $\alpha=\operatorname{cont}(\mu)$. [F1, F2, F5, F6, algebra]

Its line datum satisfies the native quadratic symmetry and homogeneous extremal conditions with $d_i=1$, and its standard exponents are exactly $\lambda_i=\#\{j:m_j=i\}$. On every finite interval its support proof gives actual whole-algebra equality, global nilpotent dots and polynomial projectors over k, not just a supported corner. The two local suppliers in [F2] use the SAME native $\tau$ and set $\psi=-\tau$: both have $\psi u-v\psi=-1$, $\psi v-u\psi=1$, quadratic $Q_{a,a+1}=v-u$, $Q_{a+1,a}=u-v$, and braid difference $\psi_1\psi_2\psi_1-\psi_2\psi_1\psi_2=[Q(u,v)-Q(w,v)]/(w-u)$ on $(a,b,a)$. Their pair series are fixed for all integer pairs and all ranks; the nondegenerate symbol q is our $\xi$. Their proofs give faithful ACTUAL affine polynomial presentations before completion and before any quotient, then identify the true central completions with one formal dot ring per word. They prove both map directions on all five equality patterns of three colors, including all equal, and inverse composites with the displayed right multiplication order. Therefore they apply to exactly the affine blocks under consideration; no finite cyclic quantum characteristic, generic-rank faithfulness or cyclotomic polynomial faithfulness is assumed. Let $k$ have characteristic zero, let $\xi\in k^\times$ have infinite
multiplicative order, and fix a finite integral multicharge
$m_1,\ldots,m_\ell$. Write $S=\{m_j:1\le j\le\ell\}$.
Use the arbitrary-base presentations of
[[def-type-a-affine-presentations-and-charged-cyclotomic-quotients]] to define
$H_d^{\deg}$ by $\prod_j(x_1-m_j)=0$ and $H_d^{\xi}$ by
$\prod_j(X_1-\xi^{m_j})=0$.
For $d>0$, every nonzero joint generalized weight in the regular module has
labels $\nu\in\mathbb Z^d$, with eigenvalues $\nu_r$ respectively
$\xi^{\nu_r}$, and
$$\min_{s\in S}|\nu_r-s|\le d-1.$$
Thus both algebras have finite joint spectral decompositions defined over $k$.

[F1] The arbitrary monic cyclotomic Hecke quotients are finite-dimensional by
[[lem-cyclotomic-hecke-bounded-ordered-monomials-span]]. Their mixed and
quadratic relations are those of
[[def-type-a-affine-presentations-and-charged-cyclotomic-quotients]].

Let $k$ have characteristic zero, let $W$ be a finite interval in $\mathbb Z$, and let $\beta$ be a multiset of $n$ colors in $W$. Orient $a\to a+1$ and put
$$Q_{aa}=0,\qquad Q_{a,a+1}(u,v)=v-u,\qquad Q_{a+1,a}(u,v)=u-v,\qquad Q_{ab}=1\ (|a-b|>1).$$
Let $R_\beta$ be the KLR algebra of this finite type-A datum in the native convention of [[def-quiver-hecke-klr-algebra-for-a-symmetrizable-cartan-datum]], and put $\psi_r=-\tau_r$, $y_r=x_r^{\mathrm{KLR}}$. Let $H_n^{\mathrm{dg}}$ be the affine degenerate Hecke algebra with $s_r^2=1$, the symmetric-group braid relations, commuting $x_r$, and $s_rx_{r+1}-x_rs_r=1$, the same generator presentation as [[def-degenerate-affine-hecke-algebra]], here imposed over $k$. Complete $H_n^{\mathrm{dg}}$ at the central ideal generated by $f(x)-f(\beta)$ for symmetric polynomials $f$, and complete $R_\beta$ at the central ideal generated by positive-degree symmetric polynomials in $y$. Denote these completions by $\widehat H_\beta^{\mathrm{dg}}$ and $\widehat R_\beta$.

[F2] The arbitrary-base degenerate presentation of [[def-type-a-affine-presentations-and-charged-cyclotomic-quotients]] specialized to k has exactly the relations listed in the Statement. It agrees over $\mathbb C$ with [[def-degenerate-affine-hecke-algebra]]; no base-change of an unproved basis is assumed, because its affine basis and faithful action over k are proved below. The generators $s_r$ permute positions; the distinct notation $\sigma_r$ below means actual permutation operators on polynomial or formal coefficient functions.
